headline: Russian Ballistic Missile Strikes Hit Kyiv Bridges and Cause Power Outages
summary: Russian missile strikes targeted three major bridges across the Dnipro River in Kyiv, killing three people and injuring 15. The attacks damaged critical infrastructure and triggered emergency blackout measures across several districts.
why: Kyiv is the capital of Ukraine. Military strikes on civilian infrastructure impact Black Sea regional stability and European energy supply lines.

impacts.name: Ukraine
impacts.why: Damage to Kyiv's bridges and electricity infrastructure disrupts local transport and energy grids.
